concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-001 (download and parse Pantheon+ dataset) has no associated task. No task in tasks.md is tagged [FR-001] or otherwise clearly implements this requirement.
Functional Requirement FR-002 (calculate distance‑modulus residuals) is not covered by any task. Tasks reference [US1] etc., but not FR-002.
Functional Requirement FR-003 (project residuals onto HEALPix grid) lacks a matching task. No task mentions HEALPix projection or carries a [FR-003] tag.
Functional Requirement FR-004 (compute spherical‑harmonic coefficients and extract dipole/quadrupole) is not linked to any task. No task is tagged [FR-004] or describes this analysis.

Functional Requirement FR-005 (generate isotropic mock catalogs via random rotations) has no corresponding task. Tasks T009 and T010 mention simulations but are tagged [US3] rather than the required FR identifier.
Functional Requirement FR-006 (flag statistically significant anisotropy) is not represented by any task. No task carries a [FR-006] tag or describes p‑value assessment.
Success Criterion SC-001 (fraction of supernovae mapped to HEALPix) is not covered by any task. No task mentions measuring this fraction.
Success Criterion SC-002 (reproducibility of dipole amplitude) lacks a dedicated task. No task references validation against a canonical implementation.
Success Criterion SC-003 (stability of null distribution) is not linked to any task. The convergence check described in the plan is not reflected in tasks.md.
Success Criterion SC-004 (runtime against GitHub Actions free‑tier limit) is missing from tasks. No task records or validates total runtime.
Task T001 and many others use tags like [US1], [US2], [US3] which do not correspond to any defined User Story or ID in the specification. These tags are stale and provide no traceability.
Task T003 (Configure linting and formatting tools) is not linked to any functional requirement or success criterion, making it an orphan quality‑gate task.
Task T004 is tagged [US1] but the specification does not define a US‑1 identifier; the tag is therefore stale.
Task T005 carries the tag [US1] which is undefined in the spec, resulting in a stale reference.
Task T006 is tagged [US2] but no US‑2 exists in the specification; the tag is stale.
Task T007 uses tag [US2] which is not defined; this is a stale tag.
Task T008 is tagged [US2] yet the spec contains no US‑2 identifier; the tag is stale.

Task T010 is tagged [US3] but no such user story exists; the tag is stale.
Task T011 uses tag [US2] which does not correspond to any defined identifier in the spec.
Task T012 is tagged [US3] yet the specification does not define a US‑3; the tag is stale.
Task T013 carries tag [US3] which is undefined; this is a stale reference.
Task T014 is tagged [US3] but no such user story exists in the spec; the tag is stale.
Task T015 is tagged [US3] yet the spec contains no US‑3 identifier; the tag is stale.
